title: Waterhouse et al., thermal decomposition of silver oxides (PCCP 2001)
supports: Ag2O fully decomposes to Ag + O2 by 673 K (~400 C); companion XPS study (unibo index) shows partial dissociation at 300 C; RSC Adv 2012 says Ag2O stable in gas only below ~170 C (via search snippet). Used against DIODE-TOWER AgOx anode surviving <=400 C processing. Query 1 of 4 (rt-PROC).

title: 3D NAND Race Faces Huge Tech And Cost Challenges
supports: TechInsights' J. Choe: going to 96 layers cut cost only ~10-15% (via search snippet). Implies ~55-70% of NAND wafer cost scales with layer count at 64 layers, i.e. ~$20-38 per ONON layer pair at a $2.5-3.5k wafer [rt-PROC ESTIMATE]. LithoVision/IC Knowledge (semiwiki 283426) projects bit cost leveling at 300-400 layers. Used against $10/plate and $25-30/tier inputs. Query 4 of 4 (rt-PROC).
